privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introBody: This policy explains how Küa collects, uses and protects your personal information. We operate under Quebec's Law 25 and apply GDPR principles where applicable.
privacy.dataCollectedBody: Depending on your use of the platform, we may collect:

dataItems.payments: Payment data (tokenized through our processor; we never store card numbers).
dataItems.technical: Technical data: IP address, browser type, essential session cookies.

privacy.purposeBody: Your data is used solely to: manage your appointment, contact you in case of change, compute commissions and taxes, comply with our legal obligations (fiscal retention). No resale, no external advertising use.
privacy.retentionBody: Fiscal data retained for 6 years (Revenu Québec). Inactive client data deleted after 7 years without visit, or upon explicit request.
privacy.rightsBody: Under Law 25 and GDPR, you can request:

rightsItems.access: Access to data held about you.
rightsItems.deletion: Deletion of personal data (subject to fiscal obligations).
rightsItems.portability: Portability: export your data in a reusable format.

privacy.contactBody: For any data-related request, email wrivard@kua.quebec. You may also file a complaint with the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.
privacy.seeTerms: See also the Terms of Service →

cookieBanner.body: We use a small set of strictly necessary cookies to keep you signed in and remember your active shop. We don't use tracking or advertising cookies. <link>Read the full policy</link>.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.commitment: Küa is committed to making its salon-management platform usable by everyone, including people relying on assistive technologies (screen readers, keyboard-only navigation, voice control, etc.).
accessibility.standardBody: Küa targets WCAG 2.1 Level AA conformance. Where individual pages fall short, the limitation is documented below.

measures.contrast: Colour palette tuned for 4.5:1 minimum text contrast and 3:1 for UI components.
measures.keyboard: Every interactive element reachable via Tab, with a visible 2px accent focus ring.
measures.aria: Form controls have associated labels; status announcements use aria-live where relevant.
measures.ci: An automated axe-core check runs in CI against the login page, public booking flow, and this statement — regressions block deployment.

accessibility.limitationsIntro: We're transparent about where the platform doesn't yet meet our target standard:

limitations.calendarDnd: Drag-and-drop on the appointments calendar has no direct keyboard equivalent yet. Keyboard users can open an appointment's detail drawer and use the 'Reschedule' button to copy a customer-facing reschedule link, then paste it to the client — a viable workaround until we add a keyboard reschedule action.
limitations.thirdParty: Embedded Stripe Elements (payment fields) inherit Stripe's a11y posture, which we don't fully control.

accessibility.reportBody: Hit an accessibility wall? Tell us at <email>wrivard@kua.quebec</email> — we treat access barriers as bugs and target a 5-business-day acknowledgement.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.acceptanceBody: By using the Küa platform, you accept these terms. If you don't accept them, don't use the service.
terms.serviceBody: Küa is a management platform for hair salons and barbershops. It includes online booking, inventory management, commission tracking, and payment processing (via a third-party processor).
terms.accountBody: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for any activity from your account. Notify us immediately in case of unauthorized access.
terms.cancellationBody: Cancellation rules are set by each shop. A late cancellation may trigger fees. Check the shop policy before booking.
terms.liabilityBody: Küa provides the platform 'as is'. We are not responsible for the services rendered by the shops; the service contract is between you and the shop.
terms.lawBody: These terms are governed by the laws of Quebec and Canada. Any dispute will be submitted to the courts of the Montreal district.
